notes.title: Free Content Update! 2 Horde maps and 2 Score Attack OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/0d002222a0467f59f01863ed59fe3cac5a371a57.jpg[/img]

Attention adventurers, the latest Strange Brigade update is rolling out [b]RIGHT NOW[/b] and includes three [b]FREE[/b] maps for all players! This update also includes various bug fixes, accessibility updates and more, so keep those peepers peeled...

[b]Patch Notes[/b][list]
[*]New free Horde map “Tunnels”.
[*]New free Score Attack Map “The Towering Temple II”.
[*]New free Score Attack Map “Cursed Village II”.
[*]Improved subtitle options including the ability to change scale and visibility.
[*]Various bug fixes and stability improvements.[/list]

[b]*Don't forget the Season Pass content is coming out tomorrow![/b]
